This contract is a custodial escrow, not a bridge: USDT deposited here sits in this contract's balance until the owner moves it - there is no on-chain mechanism connecting Ethereum and Xode (Xode has no live Snowbridge connection as of writing). On    Xode the deposit is cancelled first, so a refunded deposit can never also be paid out there.  - `refundFee` (raising it is a queued change) is only charged when the depositor's own minimum    couldn't be met, so a tight minimum isn't a free option on the price at the operator's cost.  - `minDeposit` keeps out dust deposits that would only ever turn into refunds.  - Ownership moves in two steps, so a wrong owner address can never take the gateway.","version":1}},"settings":{"compilationTarget":{"src/ethereum/EthUsdtGateway.sol":"EthUsdtGateway"},"evmVersion":"cancun","libraries":{},"metadata":{"bytecodeHash":"ipfs"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":200},"remappings":[":forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/"]},"sources":{"src/Custodial.sol":{"keccak256":"0x9560314adbcf1436bfc3c83fc02853f3a277f6946299c3592302fdd7702990e5","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://9ea765c7d09fd4ae308c3dd31740582c624237e654beb3f514b00b03bbf6b1ea","dweb:/ipfs/QmYspgW9ptxw8R5ywJsxCixFsNJNxeC2LzFKCMiKHJymTg"]},"src/ethereum/EthUsdtGateway.sol":{"keccak256":"0x10be5ca83f2b0dacf2105c220b3ed46a43c08a5e500ebefd46eb4d22bd3f6c79","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://6cc0c30806df45ada47f69bfd57c4de5bb005d8d566c7abf9885a432243964d3","dweb:/ipfs/QmVifS1ayvXBb5qVwyrGypKFR8eccBXRoRmJkhhi23oiB2"]},"src/interfaces/IERC20.sol":{"keccak256":"0x311bc8e76659b8003b582a1493843da9b42dde90dcf11e05cb91cb9ccbf3f208","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://f8dc24b42c9d5a029fbeeee8f5850cef9132beae135fba84e79961bb185cead4","dweb:/ipfs/QmPi2GVAVZqkgC1HFQJWavZ4TCSs6TMhEgU2xhnjsQeiFh"]}},"version":1}

addAttester(address).notice: Adding an attester is a queued change (see `Custodial`).

cancelChange(bytes32).notice: The owner withdrawing a queued change, or the guardian stopping one.

cancelTreasuryChange().notice: The owner withdrawing its own proposal, or the guardian stopping one it didn't expect.

constructor.notice: `treasury_` is where withdrawals go (a cold multisig in production) and `guardian_` the key or multisig that can pause and veto treasury changes - both may start as `owner_` in development.

deposit(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Deposits `usdtAmount` USDT (requires a prior `usdt.approve(address(this), usdtAmount)`) and records `xodeBeneficiary` as who should receive the resulting XON on Xode. The relayer picks this up from the `Deposited` event and pays out for its `usdtAmount` - which is what actually arrived in this contract, not what was asked for, so a token that takes a fee on transfer (Ethereum USDT has a fee switch, currently off) can never be paid out above what the gateway really holds. `minXonOut` is the least XON (18-decimal units) the depositor accepts: the payout is worked out from the vending contract's rate when the deposit settles, minutes later, and that rate can be lowered in between. Set it from the quote you were shown, less a small tolerance.

depositForSwap(uint256,address,uint256).notice: Like `deposit`, but asks to be paid at the Xode DEX's market price, receiving at least `minXonOut` XON (18-decimal units, as Solidity sees native XON on Xode) or a refund. Set it from a fresh quote minus your slippage tolerance. If USDT ever charges a transfer fee, the swap is for what arrived, so a tight minimum may then be refunded instead.

depositRecords(uint256).notice: keccak256(abi.encode(depositor, usdtAmount)) per deposit nonce, until it's refunded.

finishSetup().notice: Ends the setup phase: from now on the risky setters need `queueChange`. Irreversible.

guardianPause().notice: The guardian can stop the contract (not restart it - that's the owner's `setPaused(false)`).

isAttester(address).notice: Attesters whose signatures authorise a refund (`refundAttested`) - the same independent relayers that vote on Xode. A threshold of 0 (the default) leaves refunds to the owner alone.

minDeposit().notice: Smallest deposit accepted, in raw USDT units.

owed().notice: USDT still owed to depositors: every deposit that hasn't been refunded or released (marked paid on Xode). `withdraw` can never dip into it, so a refund is always covered.

pendingOwner().notice: Nominated by `transferOwnership`; becomes owner once it calls `acceptOwnership`.

queueChange(bytes).notice: Queues `call` - the exact calldata of a later call to this contract - to be allowed after `CHANGE_DELAY`. Its id is `keccak256(call)`; watch `ChangeQueued` to see what's coming.

queuedChangeReadyAt(bytes32).notice: keccak256(calldata) of a queued call -> when it may run (0: not queued).

refund(uint256,address,uint256,bool).notice: Pays deposit `nonce` back, once - for a deposit that can't be paid out on Xode (cancel it there first with `XonVendingMachine.cancelExternalDeposit`). It goes to the depositor, or to the address the depositor named. `depositor` and `usdtAmount` must match the deposit's event; they're checked against the record. `chargeFee` keeps `refundFee` back - meant only for a deposit whose own minimum the pool couldn't meet, never for the operator's own failures.

refundAddress(uint256).notice: Where a deposit's refund goes instead of its depositor, if the depositor said so.

refundAttested(uint256,address,uint256,b.notice: The same refund, authorised by the attesters instead of the owner: anyone may submit it with signatures from `attestationThreshold` different attesters over `refundDigest` (EIP-191 personal-sign), ordered by signer address, ascending. Attesters sign only once the deposit is cancelled on Xode (`XonVendingMachine.attestExternalCancel`), and that vote also fixes `chargeFee` - so a refund needs no owner transaction on either chain, and nobody picks the fee alone.

refundDigest(uint256,address,uint256,boo.notice: What attesters sign to authorise a refund: bound to this chain and this gateway.

refundFee().notice: Kept from a refund when `refund` is told to charge it, in raw USDT units.

release(uint256[],address[],uint256[]).notice: Marks deposits as paid on Xode: their USDT stops being owed (so it can be withdrawn) and they can no longer be refunded. Each entry must match its deposit's event, like `refund`.

removeAttester(address).notice: Removing one is instant, and the guardian can do it too, as long as enough remain.

setAttestationThreshold(uint256).notice: 0 turns attested refunds off. Raising the threshold is instant; lowering it, or turning attested refunds on, is a queued change.

setRefundAddress(uint256,uint256,address.notice: The depositor of `nonce` (for `usdtAmount`, as in its event) names where a refund should go - for instance if USDT has frozen the depositing address. Only ever affects that deposit.

setRefundFee(uint256).notice: Lowering the fee is instant; raising it is a queued change (see `Custodial`).

setupFinished().notice: Until `finishSetup` (or the first `transferOwnership`), the deployer configures the contract freely; after it, the risky setters need a queued change.

transferOwnership(address).notice: Nominates `newOwner`, who becomes owner by calling `acceptOwnership`. `address(0)` cancels. Handing the contract over also ends its setup phase.

withdraw(uint256).notice: Moves custodied USDT to the treasury - the only place it can go besides a refund. Only what isn't owed to a depositor any more: deposits `release`d as paid on Xode, and refund fees.

withdrawable().notice: USDT the owner may move to the treasury right now: the balance less what's still `owed`.
